official_documentation.title: Extract Text from a PDF
supports: PdfReader exposes pages and page.extract_text(), including a layout extraction mode.
PDF text extraction and table reconstruction can be ambiguous; page appearance alone is not a semantic table.
official_documentation.limits: This library is not OCR. Image-only scans can yield little or no text and need an appropriate OCR workflow. This is a limitation of our selected local extraction route, not a claim about all multimodal AI products.
official_documentation.production_requirement: Record the actually installed library version separately. Extract and inspect every source page before scripting any successful result.

official_documentation.title: Using formulae
official_documentation.supports: A workbook can contain Excel formula strings written by openpyxl.
official_documentation.limits: openpyxl does not evaluate those formulas. Do not label blank cached values as calculated spreadsheet results.
official_documentation.production_requirement: Verify numeric values independently, and either supply explicit calculated-value columns alongside formulas or use a real spreadsheet engine and record that actual recalculation.

Keep a visible row-to-source-page trail rather than displaying an invented chat conversation.
Treat not stated as unknown, preserve a nonmatching offer and produce questions for the supplier.
Show tax and shipping included in a transparent arithmetic basis before sorting eligible offers.
Revise the requested quantity once and show actual changes and unchanged terms.
Conclude with the editable comparison, one source trace and the specific limitation of text-PDF extraction.
